title: Comedy Night Trivia
shortDescription: Comedy Night Trivia at The Mill at Fountain Inn. A fun, comedy-themed team trivia night with Four Dogs Entertainment.
description: Think you know your comedy? Bring your friends to The Mill at Fountain Inn for Comedy Night Trivia with Four Dogs Entertainment. Gather a team, answer questions inspired by favorite funny movies, TV comedies, and memorable pop-culture moments, and enjoy a night full of laughs and friendly competition. This is a hosted trivia game, not a stand-up comedy show.
instructions: Contact the venue for seating or participation details. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
